verdict.rationale: HeyGen's docs describe revising only the named scenes of a Video Agent video while untouched scenes keep their script and visuals. That is the product's own segment-level regeneration capability, which covers the story's core. A second line about updating lines without returning to the studio loosely supports script-level edits. missing for 10: any documented clip-extension capability, explicit confirmation that unchanged scenes are not re-rendered (render time or credit savings), coverage outside Video Agent videos, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
